subject: Can't repeat Mplus Invariance analysis with Lavaan

messages.author: 7970819afe85b3e6
messages.subject: Can't repeat Mplus Invariance analysis with Lavaan
parts:
Dear All,

I managed to make two identical analyses with Mplus and Lavaan where the Configural Model is the following in lavaan:


data3 <- read.csv2("dataWeek4c.csv", sep = "\t")
remain_free = c("ITEM1","ITEM2","ITEM3","ITEM4","ITEM5","ITEM6","ITEM7","ITEM8","ITEM9","ITEM10","ITEM11","ITEM12","ITEM13","ITEM14","ITEM15","ITEM16","ITEM17","ITEM18","ITEM19","ITEM20","ITEM21","ITEM22")

baseline <- "F1 =~ ITEM1 + ITEM2 + ITEM3 + ITEM6 + ITEM8 + ITEM13 + ITEM14 + ITEM16 + ITEM20 + ITEM12 + c(0,NA)* ITEM11
         F2 =~ ITEM5 + ITEM10 + ITEM11 + ITEM15 + ITEM22
             F3 =~ ITEM4 + ITEM7 + ITEM9 + ITEM12 + ITEM17 + ITEM18 + ITEM19 + ITEM21
             ITEM1 ~~ ITEM2
         ITEM6 ~~ ITEM16
         ITEM10 ~~ ITEM11
         ITEM7 ~~ c(NA,0)*ITEM4
             ITEM9 ~~ c(0,NA)*ITEM19"

configural <- cfa(baseline, data = data3, group="group", group.equal=c("means"), estimator = "MLM", group.partial = remain_free, mimic = "Mplus")

The corresponding syntax in MPLUS is pasted below:

INPUT INSTRUCTIONS
 
  TITLE: Testing for Invariance of MBI across Elementary/Secondary Teachers
         Common Baseline (Configural) Model (Byrne 2012, p. 209)
 
  DATA:
    FILE (Elem) IS "MBIELM1.DAT";
    FILE (Sec)  IS "MBISEC1.DAT";
 
  VARIABLE: NAMES ARE ITEM1 - ITEM22;
     USEVARIABLES ARE ITEM1 - ITEM22;
 
  ANALYSIS: ESTIMATOR = MLM;
 
  MODEL: ! "overall" model section
    F1 BY ITEM1 - ITEM3 ITEM6 ITEM8 ITEM13 ITEM14 ITEM16 ITEM20;
    F1 BY ITEM12; ! common cross-loading (from baseline models)
    F2 BY ITEM5 ITEM10 ITEM11 ITEM15 ITEM22;
    F3 BY ITEM4 ITEM7 ITEM9 ITEM12 ITEM17 - ITEM19 ITEM21;
 
    ! common modifications (from baseline models)
    ITEM6 WITH ITEM16;
    ITEM1 WITH ITEM2;
    ITEM10 WITH ITEM11;
 
    [F1@0 F2@0 F3@0]; ! factor means constrained to zero
 
  ! group-specific model parameters:
 
  MODEL Elem:
    ITEM7 WITH ITEM4; ! specific residual covariance (from baseline model)
 
  MODEL Sec:
    F1 BY ITEM11; ! specific cross-loading (from baseline model)
    ITEM19 WITH ITEM9; ! specific residual covariance (from baseline model)
 
    ! RELAX the following equality constraints, i.e., specify those
    ! parameters that are NOT constrained equal:
    ! (OBS: the first items excluded because of their special role)
 
    F1 BY       ITEM2 ITEM3 ITEM6 ITEM8 ITEM13 ITEM14 ITEM16 ITEM20;
    F1 BY ITEM12; ! common cross-loading (from baseline models)
    F2 BY       ITEM10 ITEM11 ITEM15 ITEM22;
    F3 BY       ITEM7 ITEM9 ITEM12 ITEM17 - ITEM19 ITEM21;
 
    [ITEM1 - ITEM22]; ! intercepts NOT constrained equal

However, when I am trying to do the next step, I am apparently doing something wrong. I am trying to analyze the weak invariance between Elm and Sec  or (group == 1 and group == 2), with the following syntax in Mplus (which produces the "correct" results required for our course):

DATA:
  FILE (Elem) IS "MBIELM1.DAT";
  FILE (Sec)  IS "MBISEC1.DAT";
 
VARIABLE: NAMES ARE ITEM1 - ITEM22;
   USEVARIABLES ARE ITEM1 - ITEM22;
 
ANALYSIS: ESTIMATOR = MLM;
 
MODEL: ! "overall" model section
  F1 BY ITEM1 - ITEM3 ITEM6 ITEM8 ITEM13 ITEM14 ITEM16 ITEM20;
  F1 BY ITEM12; ! common cross-loading (from baseline models)
  F2 BY ITEM5 ITEM10 ITEM11 ITEM15 ITEM22;
  F3 BY ITEM4 ITEM7 ITEM9 ITEM12 ITEM17 - ITEM19 ITEM21;
 
  ! common modifications (from baseline models)
  ITEM6 WITH ITEM16;
  ITEM1 WITH ITEM2;
  ITEM10 WITH ITEM11;
 
  [F1@0 F2@0 F3@0]; ! factor means constrained to zero
 
! group-specific model parameters:
 
MODEL Elem:
  ITEM7 WITH ITEM4; ! specific residual covariance (from baseline model)
 
MODEL Sec:
  F1 BY ITEM11; ! specific cross-loading (from baseline model)
  ITEM19 WITH ITEM9; ! specific residual covariance (from baseline model)
 
  ! RELAXED constraints of the configural model REMOVED!
 
  [ITEM1 - ITEM22]; ! intercepts NOT constrained equal

I assumed that the corresponding analysis with lavaan would have been the following, (but apparently it is not) :

configural <- cfa(baseline, data = data3, group="group", group.equal=c("means", "loadings"), estimator = "MLM", group.partial = remain_free, mimic = "Mplus")


The Mplus analysis had 421 degrees of freedom and the Lavaan analysis has 422. What am I doing wrong? If needed, I can share the data files too. Out-puts for both of the analyses have been posted below as well.

Please help me, I have been reading the documentation for two days now and I can't figure it out.


With all the best,

--Michael

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Can't repeat Mplus Invariance analysis with Lavaan
parts:
On 11/30/2014 01:36 PM, Michael Laakasuo wrote:
> I did. I found the problem. The term that is missing is F1 =~ c(0, NA)*ITEM1
> However, this term is in my model, but it is dropped from the fitted
> model. Although this same term WORKS in the baselinemodel, it is only
> dropped when I add the groups.equal = "loadings" that this is dropped.
>
> How do I fix this?

You can use the group.partial= argument, to free up a factor loading.
But for 'custom' equality constraints, I would avoid the
convenient-but-global group.equal= argument, and use labels. So, 'equal'
factor loadings get the same label, as in

F1 =~ c(l1, l1)*ITEM1

while those that are allowed to be free get a different label:

F1 =~ c(l1, l2)*ITEM1

If, in addition, you need to fix 'l1' to zero, while 'l2' should be
free, you can write

F =~ c(l1, l2)*ITEM1 + c(0, NA)*ITEM1

Yves.
